services.name: Hilot Massage
services.description: Traditional Filipino healing massage using warm coconut oil and banana leaves. A 90-minute ritual that restores the body and quiets the mind.

services.name: Hot Stone Therapy
services.description: Volcanic stones heated to 55°C release deep muscle tension while grounding the nervous system. Paired with aromatherapy.

services.name: Botanical Facial
services.description: A curative treatment using locally sourced aloe vera, papaya enzymes, and volcanic clay to restore skin radiance.

services.name: Private Lagoon Dinner
services.description: A candlelit table set on the water's edge. Personal chef, sommelier, and a menu crafted for you the same morning.

services.name: Culinary Experience
services.description: Forage local ingredients with our head chef, then cook traditional Philippine dishes in the resort's open kitchen.

services.name: Wine & Tapas Evening
services.description: Curated pairings from our 400-label cellar, served on the terrace as the sun sets over the water.

services.name: Private Island Hop
services.description: A chartered bangka boat takes you to three uninhabited islands. Packed lunch, snorkel gear, and a guide included.

services.name: Waterfall Trek
services.description: Guided 4-hour hike through jungle trails to a hidden twin waterfall. Swim in crystal pools fed by mountain springs.

services.name: Reef Diving
services.description: PADI-certified instructors lead dives to pristine coral reefs 15 minutes offshore. Beginners welcome.
